units: <cite ref="Yevamot 71b:19">Yeb. 71ᵇ</cite> <he>ובמדבר מ״ט לא מָהוּל</he> and why did they not practice circumcision in the desert? <cite ref="Yevamot 72a:3">Ib. 72ᵃ</cite> <he>לא מַהֲלִינָן ביה</he> we do not perform the operation on it (a cloudy day &c.).
<cite ref="Shabbat 134a:14">Sabb. 134ᵃ</cite> <he>ולִימְהֲלֵיה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ולִימְהֲלוּהָ</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) and then one (they) shall circumcise him.

<cite ref="Shabbat 136a:1">Ib. 136ᵃ</cite> <he>מִימְהַל היכי מַהֲלִינָן ליה</he> how dare we circumcise him (on the Sabbath)? <cite ref="Shabbat 136a:1">Ib.</cite> <he>נִימְהֲלֵיה ממ״נ</he> let us circumcise him at all events (v. <cite ref="M00340"><he>מָה</he></cite> h.); a. fr.—Part. <he>מָהֵיל</he>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 39a:10">Snh. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>אנן דמהלינן וכ׳</he> we who are circumcised cannot become like you; <he>אתון מַהֲלִיתוּ וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>מיהלן</he>, read <he>מְהִילוּ</he>) have yourselves circumcised and be like us.
